translated_title: 25 Experts from the Mexican Red Cross, Dogs, and Equipment Join Rescues in Venezuela
original_title: Se suman 25 expertos de la Cruz Roja Mexicana, canes y equipo a rescates de Venezuela
author: Laura Poy and Arturo Sánchez
meta_description: The 25-member team flew out of Toluca with five canine units and 3.5 tons of gear for a 14-day mission, as Venezuela's quake toll passes 1,430 dead.
